Between 23:43 and 03:04 seven families changed with no migration recorded (the latest is still 20261123231917): columns gained two (3,189 to 3,191), and constraints, indexes, inheritance, publication_tables, relations and types changed with the same counts. That rotation accounts for the changes with unchanged counts; the two columns came from outside this repository's migrations. extension_readings.purpose: Read once to find what a schema-only dump cannot carry for production's extensions. Each query returned the server's MD5 of the text it received before the connector's own trailing comment (text_md5), which equals the MD5 of the query as written, and the server's length, which is that text plus the 108-character comment. Owner and privilege names are role names; no row of any table was read. The exact text of each query is in query_texts.

initial_privileges.compared: Each per-extension count and MD5 (privtype e rows of pg_init_privs, by object identity) equals a fresh install on supabase/postgres:17.6.1.063 or .085 except pg_stat_statements (production a6ec80d3..., fresh ecda650c...), whose initial privileges name postgres. The image's default versions of all ten extensions equal production's.

member_privileges.columns: per extension and member type: members, members with an explicit privilege list, grantees, grantors, MD5 of identity|owner|privileges

shared_dependencies.columns: rows: production's pg_shdepend rows on roles that extension-ownership.sql reads (each extension's owner row, 'o', and every initial-privilege row, 'i'), as [type, object type, object names, object arguments, role]; restore_rule: the same rows as restore-full.sh's ownership step writes them from production's pg_init_privs and extension owners; by_kind: type/object type/role counts; MD5 of the rows' JSON text sorted bytewise and joined by newlines
shared_dependencies.compared: Production's rows equal what the restore's ownership step writes (nothing only in either, same MD5), so production's history left no shared dependency the step would not rebuild, and the first operator run cannot stop on that check because of it. The MD5 equals the shared_dependencies of the production-like stand-in's reading (14 rows), which the restore reproduced and matched in every family.

extension_readings.consequence: pgcrypto, uuid-ossp and pg_stat_statements and all their members belong to postgres. A restore as supabase_admin makes them supabase_admin's, so a faithful copy differed in acls, extensions, functions, relations and types (shown on a scratch copy). The schemas graphql and graphql_public keep initial privileges from pg_graphql, which production no longer has, so pg_dump writes no grant for them and a restored copy would have lost their privileges. release-full now reproduces, from the bundle's reading (extension-ownership.json, format 2), extension owners, extension-recorded initial privileges, those two schemas' privileges and the shared dependencies PostgreSQL keeps for them, after restoring everything but the privileges and before restoring those, and then compares. Read on November 26 at 04:41 UTC: production's shared dependencies on roles for these (3 extension owner rows and 11 initial-privilege rows) are exactly what the restore's step rebuilds.

query_texts.initial_privileges:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('reading','extension-initial-privileges/1','query_md5',md5(current_query()),'query_length',length(current_query()),'text_md5',md5(split_part(current_query(),E'\n\n-- source: POST /mcp',1)),
  'captured_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'client',jsonb_build_object('application_name',current_setting('application_name'),'session_user',session_user::text),
  'pg_net_initial_privileges_granting_postgres',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_init_privs i WHERE ((i.classoid='pg_catalog.pg_namespace'::pg_catalog.regclass AND i.objoid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname='net')) OR (i.classoid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND i.objoid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='net'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(i.initprivs) a WHERE a.grantee=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname='postgres'))),
  'extensions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)) ORDER BY e.extname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension e JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace),
  'initial_privileges',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.k,jsonb_build_array(x.cnt,x.dig)) FROM (
    SELECT coalesce(e.extname,'-') k,count(*) cnt,
      md5(string_agg(concat_ws('|',i.type,i.identity,p.privtype,ARRAY(SELECT acl::text FROM unnest(p.initprivs) acl ORDER BY acl::text COLLATE "C")::text),E'\n' ORDER BY i.type COLLATE "C",i.identity COLLATE "C",p.privtype)) dig
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_init_privs p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(p.classoid,p.objoid,p.objsubid) i
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_depend d ON d.classid=p.classoid AND d.objid=p.objoid AND d.objsubid=0 AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid
    WHERE p.privtype='e'
    GROUP BY 1) x)) AS reading;
query_texts.owners:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('reading','extension-owners/1','query_length',length(current_query()),'text_md5',md5(split_part(current_query(),E'\n\n-- source: POST /mcp',1)),
  'captured_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'client',jsonb_build_object('application_name',current_setting('application_name'),'session_user',session_user::text),
  'member_owners',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.k,x.n) FROM (
    SELECT e.extname||'/'||pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)||'/'||i.type||'/'||coalesce(pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(coalesce(
      (SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass AND p.oid=d.objid),
      (SELECT c.relowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND c.oid=d.objid),
      (SELECT t.typowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_type'::pg_catalog.regclass AND t.oid=d.objid),
      (SELECT o.oprowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator o WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_operator'::pg_catalog.regclass AND o.oid=d.objid),
      (SELECT n.nspowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_namespace'::pg_catalog.regclass AND n.oid=d.objid))),'-') k,count(*) n
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension e ON d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.oid=d.refobjid
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,0) i
    WHERE d.deptype='e' GROUP BY 1) x),
  'pg_stat_statements_initial_privileges',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i.identity,p.privtype,ARRAY(SELECT acl::text FROM unnest(p.initprivs) acl ORDER BY acl::text COLLATE "C")::text) ORDER BY i.identity)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_init_privs p CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(p.classoid,p.objoid,p.objsubid) i
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_depend d ON d.classid=p.classoid AND d.objid=p.objoid AND d.objsubid=0 AND d.deptype='e'
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid AND e.extname='pg_stat_statements')) AS reading;
query_texts.member_privileges:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('reading','extension-member-privileges/1','query_length',length(current_query()),'text_md5',md5(split_part(current_query(),E'\n\n-- source: POST /mcp',1)),
  'captured_at',to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'client',jsonb_build_object('application_name',current_setting('application_name'),'session_user',session_user::text),
  'members',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.k,jsonb_build_array(x.n,x.with_acl,x.grantees,x.grantors,x.dig)) FROM (
    SELECT e.extname||'/'||i.type k,count(*) n,count(m.acl) with_acl,
      (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g,',' ORDER BY g) FROM unnest(array_agg(m.grantees)) g WHERE g IS NOT NULL) grantees,
      (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g,',' ORDER BY g) FROM unnest(array_agg(m.grantors)) g WHERE g IS NOT NULL) grantors,
      md5(string_agg(i.identity||'|'||coalesce(m.owner,'-')||'|'||coalesce(m.acl,'-'),E'\n' ORDER BY i.identity COLLATE "C")) dig
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension e ON d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.oid=d.refobjid
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,0) i
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(
        (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass AND p.oid=d.objid),
        (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND c.oid=d.objid)) owner,
      coalesce((SELECT ARRAY(SELECT a::text FROM unnest(p.proacl) a ORDER BY a::text COLLATE "C")::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass AND p.oid=d.objid AND p.proacl IS NOT NULL),
        (SELECT ARRAY(SELECT a::text FROM unnest(c.relacl) a ORDER BY a::text COLLATE "C")::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND c.oid=d.objid AND c.relacl IS NOT NULL)) acl,
      coalesce((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END,',') FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p, pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.proacl) x WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass AND p.oid=d.objid),
        (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END,',') FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.aclexplode(c.relacl) x WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND c.oid=d.objid)) grantees,
      coalesce((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor),',') FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p, pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.proacl) x WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass AND p.oid=d.objid),
        (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor),',') FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.aclexplode(c.relacl) x WHERE d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND c.oid=d.objid)) grantors) m
    WHERE d.deptype='e' AND e.extname IN ('pgcrypto','uuid-ossp','pg_stat_statements') AND i.type IN ('function','view')
    GROUP BY 1) x)) AS reading;
query_texts.shared_dependencies:
WITH db AS (SELECT d.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database d WHERE d.datname=pg_catalog.current_database()),
reading AS (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(s.deptype::text,a.type,a.object_names,a.object_args,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(s.refobjid)::text) x
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_shdepend s CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object_as_address(s.classid,s.objid,s.objsubid) a
  WHERE s.dbid=(SELECT db.oid FROM db) AND s.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_authid'::pg_catalog.regclass
    AND (s.deptype='i' OR (s.deptype='o' AND s.classid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass))),
rule AS (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array('o'::text,a.type,a.object_names,a.object_args,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)::text) x
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object_as_address('pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass,e.oid,0) a
    WHERE e.extowner>=12000
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array('i'::text,a.type,a.object_names,a.object_args,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(r.role)::text)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_init_privs p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT q.grantee FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.initprivs) q
      UNION SELECT q.grantor FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.initprivs) q) r(role)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object_as_address(p.classoid,p.objoid,p.objsubid) a
    WHERE r.role<>0 AND r.role>=12000),
only_reading AS (SELECT x FROM reading EXCEPT ALL SELECT x FROM rule),
only_rule AS (SELECT x FROM rule EXCEPT ALL SELECT x FROM reading)
SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('reading','extension-shared-dependencies/1','query_length',pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.current_query()),
  'text_md5',pg_catalog.md5(pg_catalog.split_part(pg_catalog.current_query(),E'\n\n-- source: POST /mcp',1)),
  'captured_at',pg_catalog.to_char(pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'client',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('application_name',pg_catalog.current_setting('application_name'),'session_user',session_user::text),
  'shared_dependencies',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('rows',pg_catalog.count(*),
      'owner_rows',pg_catalog.count(*) FILTER (WHERE x->>0='o'),'initial_privilege_rows',pg_catalog.count(*) FILTER (WHERE x->>0='i'),
      'md5',pg_catalog.md5(coalesce(pg_catalog.string_agg(x::text,E'\n' ORDER BY x::text COLLATE "C"),'')),
      'by_kind',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(z.k,z.n) FROM (SELECT (y.x->>0)||'/'||(y.x->>1)||'/'||(y.x->>4) k,pg_catalog.count(*) n
        FROM reading y GROUP BY 1) z)) FROM reading),
  'restore_rule',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('rows',pg_catalog.count(*),
      'md5',pg_catalog.md5(coalesce(pg_catalog.string_agg(x::text,E'\n' ORDER BY x::text COLLATE "C"),''))) FROM rule),
  'only_in_reading',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('rows',pg_catalog.count(*),'by_kind',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(z.k,z.n)
      FROM (SELECT (y.x->>0)||'/'||(y.x->>1)||'/'||(y.x->>4) k,pg_catalog.count(*) n FROM only_reading y GROUP BY 1) z)) FROM only_reading),
  'only_in_rule',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('rows',pg_catalog.count(*),'by_kind',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(z.k,z.n)
      FROM (SELECT (y.x->>0)||'/'||(y.x->>1)||'/'||(y.x->>4) k,pg_catalog.count(*) n FROM only_rule y GROUP BY 1) z)) FROM only_rule),
  'init_privs',(SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(z.t,z.n) FROM (SELECT p.privtype::text t,pg_catalog.count(*) n FROM pg_catalog.pg_init_privs p GROUP BY 1) z),
  'initdb_privileges_naming_unpinned_roles',(SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_init_privs p
    WHERE p.privtype='i' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.initprivs) q WHERE (q.grantee<>0 AND q.grantee>=12000) OR q.grantor>=12000))) AS reading
